boring-road: Do most tuition homes sit on Boring Road itself or in the colonies behind it?

kidwaipuri: Is Kidwaipuri the same place as P&T Colony?

digha: Does the Ganga riverfront expressway help tutors reach Digha?

bailey-road: Where does Bailey Road start and end?
